newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Anhui Expressway buys new road.
newsitem.headline: China's Anhui Expressway buys new road.

text.p: China's Anhui Expressway Co Ltd has bought a new 30-km (19-mile) section of a national highway for 210 million yuan ($25.3 million), the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
Anhui Expressway, which listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange last November, had bought a section of the Number 205 highway passing through Tianchang in central Anhui province, Xinhua said.
The Tianchang section, which opened on January 1, would handle 8,000 to 9,000 vehicles a day by 2000, the agency quoted company chairman Wang Shui as predicting.
The Number 205 highway runs from Shanhaiguan in northern Hebei province to Guangzhou, capital of southern Guangdong province, it said but gave no further details.
